rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Having considered the candidacy submitted by the President, the State Duma, under Article 103(1)(a) and by open vote, gives the President consent to appoint Putin Vladimir Vladimirovich Chairman of the Government; in force on adoption; signed by Г.Н.Селезнев, Moscow, 16 August 1999, No. 4276-II GD.
